facts.fact: PREA reports that the e-GP project team, with the public procurement regulator, the national procurement commission and the digital governance unit, held a field mission on 14-18 June 2026 in Boeny and Atsimo Andrefana to prepare progressive nationwide deployment of the e-GP platform, with its operational phase starting in 2026 and an implementation firm about to be deployed.

systems.owner: Ministry of Economy and Finance, with PREA and PRODIGY (World Bank)
